title: Repeat Customer Rate
scenario: Calculate the percentage of customers who have made more than one order. Return the result as 'repeat_rate'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Count customers with > 1 order and divide by total customers.
correctQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS cnt FROM delivery GROUP BY customer_id) t;
